summary: Movary is a web application designed to help you log and score the films you watch. It provides a centralised interface to maintain a personal archive of your cinematic history.
goodFor: It suits self-hosters who want a dedicated, private system to record their movie-watching habits without relying on commercial platforms.
watchOut: Maintenance health is moderate and the project has a modest repository size, meaning you may encounter slower responses to bug fixes or feature requests compared to larger ecosystem alternatives.
deployNotes: As a containerised PHP application, it typically requires persistent volumes for data storage and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
